turns.text: Hi Alex, Maya's in a meeting right now. Can I ask what it's regarding?
turns.say: It's about D&O insurance after your recent raise. Most boards want it sorted. When's a good time to connect with Maya?

turns.text: That'd be Maya. Hold on, let me see if I can put you through.
turns.say: Thanks for holding, Maya. Saw your $14M Series A—has anyone reviewed your D&O cover since then?

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya.

turns.text: Okay, good. Roughly how much would something like that cost us?

turns.say: Great, I'll send the invite for Thursday. Anyone else from your team you want to include?

turns.text: Just me and our CFO. Talk then.
turns.say: Thanks, Maya. I'll send that invite for Thursday at 2 PM. If anything comes up before then, just let me know.

turns.text: Yeah.
turns.say: I’ll be quick. Has anyone talked to you about D&O since your pre-seed raise?

turns.text: Look I'm slammed, I've got like two minutes.
turns.say: Understood. Has anyone reviewed your D&O since your pre-seed raise? Just a quick check.

turns.text: No.
turns.say: Got it. Quick one: with six on your team, have you checked if your current cover fits your AI product risks?

turns.text: We're not interested, thanks.
turns.say: Totally fair, nobody’s ever interested in insurance. Can I ask one quick question before I let you go?

turns.text: Fine, email it over.
turns.say: Will do. Most founders at your stage find a quick look saves hassle later. Can I grab fifteen minutes next week?

turns.text: Thank you. So what's this regarding?
turns.say: We insure many robotics startups post-Series B. Has your board reviewed D&O coverage since the raise?

turns.text: So we have a broker, we've had the same broker since basically day one, they did our general liability and the property stuff when we moved into the warehouse, and honestly they've been fine, they pick up the phone, so I'm not really looking to change anything right now.
turns.say: Makes sense, most founders do. When did they last re-quote you after a raise?

turns.text: I'd have to check. But honestly, what does something like this even cost? Our premiums already went up a lot this year.
turns.say: Totally get the premium concern. The quote call is free and shows real numbers before any decision. Would Thursday or Friday work?

turns.text: Yeah, the timing is just bad for us. We're in the middle of the audit and our renewal isn't until March, so call me next quarter and maybe we'll take a look then.
turns.say: Understood. When would be a good time next quarter to revisit this? I’ll make sure to follow up then.

turns.text: Early February could work. Send me something.
turns.say: Sure, I'll send over a summary of what other Series B robotics startups found useful in their D&O policies. Who else should I copy?
